android_error_connect_check_address: Couldn't connect — check the host's address and port.
android_identity_broken: Couldn't create an identity — this device's secure key storage isn't working
android_identity_not_ready: Identity not ready yet — try again in a moment
android_local_network_body: Android blocks Punktfunk from talking to devices on your network, so it can't find or reach any host until you allow it.
android_local_network_hint: If no prompt appears after you allow it, enable “Nearby devices” for Punktfunk in system settings.
android_shortcut_unsupported: Your home screen doesn't take shortcuts.
android_trust_mismatch_body: {host} didn't present the identity saved for it. It may be a second operating system on that host, a reinstall, or an impostor. Pair with the host's PIN to add it.
android_unlock_with_fingerprint: Unlock with fingerprint on this device
android_lnp_off_body: Android blocks Punktfunk from finding or reaching hosts until you allow it.
android_lnp_denied_body: Punktfunk can't find or reach hosts without local network access. Allow it in Android's app settings.
android_speedtest_target_default_body: This host uses the default settings, so the bitrate goes there.
android_speedtest_target_preset_body: This host streams with “{preset}”, which sets its own bitrate — that override is what it actually reads.
android_speedtest_target_ask_body: This host streams with “{preset}”, which uses the default bitrate. Set it in the preset for this host alone, or as the default for everything that uses it.
android_mgmt_unreachable: the request didn't reach the host
android_lib_identity_unavailable: Identity unavailable — you may need to pair again
android_lib_error_unpaired_first: connect to this host once first — pairing is what lets it show its games
android_lib_error_tls: couldn't set up a secure connection to the host
android_lib_error_unreachable: couldn't reach the host — check that it's on and on this network
android_lib_error_no_identity: this device has no identity yet
android_ring_screens_note: Dual-screen handhelds: the panel below, the picture below, or across both
android_ring_keyboard_not_granted: Keyboard input is not granted for this session
android_ring_send_text_unsupported: This host does not take typed text
android_hdr_unsupported_hint: This display can't present HDR10 — streams stay SDR.
android_codec_auto_av1_hint: Automatic prefers AV1 on this device.
android_stats_scale_pct_hint: The overlay's size, on top of the system display size.
android_console_unavailable_build: This build has no controller interface for this device, so the touch layout stays up.
android_console_unavailable_failed: The controller interface couldn't start on this device. Restart the app; if it keeps happening, send your logs from a host's menu.
android_player_overlay_actions_opener: {button}, a two-finger twist, {keys} or {pad_keys} on a controller opens them mid-stream.
android_player_back_opens_ring_hint: Off, {button} does nothing mid-stream, except where no twist, keyboard or controller can open quick actions.
android_keyboard_shortcuts_on_hint: Every shortcut reaches the host, Alt+Tab and the Windows key included
android_keyboard_shortcuts_hint: Turn Punktfunk on under Accessibility to send the shortcuts Android keeps for itself.
android_prefs_controllers_hint: What the app detects, with a live input test
android_preset_edit_hint: The color marks this preset on host cards, where its name doesn't fit.
android_preset_delete_note: The settings it overrides aren't lost anywhere else — the defaults stay exactly as they are.
android_about_components_intro: It uses the open-source components below, each under its own license.
android_keycapture_body_why: Android keeps Alt+Tab, the Windows key and your keyboard's language key for itself. To send them to the computer you stream from, Punktfunk uses Android's AccessibilityService API.
android_keycapture_body_what: With it on, Punktfunk receives the keys you press on a hardware keyboard. While a stream is on screen, it sends them to that computer over the encrypted connection. Outside a stream, every key passes through untouched. It can't see the screen, stores nothing and sends nothing anywhere else.
android_keycapture_body_how: Agree opens Android's Accessibility settings, where you turn on Punktfunk keyboard shortcuts. You can turn it off there at any time.
android_keycapture_service_description: Lets a stream take every keyboard shortcut, Alt+Tab and the Windows key included. Keys go only to the computer you stream from, and only while a stream is on screen; outside a stream every key passes through untouched. Nothing is stored.
android_remote_pointer_hint: Remote pointer — {select} click · {play_pause} right-click · hold {select} to exit
android_controls_remote_pointer: Steer the host's pointer with the remote, or stop
android_grant_expired: Your access to this host has expired.
android_keepalive_channel_desc: Shows the running session and keeps it alive in the background.
android_companion_stats_waiting: The numbers arrive within a second.
android_companion_trackpad_hint: Tap to click · two fingers scroll · two-finger tap right-clicks
android_pad_none_detected: No controller detected. One behind an adapter or hub may show under “Other input devices” below, or not at all.
android_pad_test_idle: Show button presses and stick motion live
android_pad_test_running: Controller input stays on this screen — hold {button} to finish
android_pad_sc2_bt_paired: Paired over Bluetooth. Punktfunk needs Bluetooth access to capture it — until then it stays in its built-in keyboard/mouse mode and no game sees a controller.
android_pad_sc_captured: Captured — streams as-is: the host presents a real {name} that its Steam drives directly (trackpads, gyro, haptics).
android_pad_rumble_sent: Sent a rumble to the controller.
android_pad_needs_usb: Needs USB access to be captured.
android_pad_passthrough_disabled: Passthrough is off — turn on “DualSense over USB” in Settings to capture it.
android_pad_needs_usb_grant: Needs USB access — grant it now and streams capture the controller silently.
android_pad_ready_ds4: Ready — captured at stream start: rumble, lightbar and gyro are driven directly.
android_pad_ready_dualsense: Ready — captured at stream start: rumble, adaptive triggers, lightbar and gyro are driven directly.

match.n=one: Haptics test passed — {count} frame to the controller.
match.n=other: Haptics test passed — {count} frames to the controller.

android_pad_haptics_open_failed: Couldn't open the controller's haptics — it still works normally
android_pad_haptics_silent: The stream opened but no audio reached the controller.
android_pad_streams_as_set: Streams as: {kind} (set in Settings; automatic would pick {auto})
android_pad_layout_playstation: Android has no button layout for this controller — read as a PlayStation controller
android_pad_layout_xbox: Android has no button layout for this controller — read as an Xbox controller
android_pad_layout_corrected: Android has no button layout for this controller — face buttons corrected
android_pad_no_rumble_motors: No rumble motors reported — host rumble will be silent
android_pad_ds_enable_passthrough: Turn on “DualSense over USB” in Settings first.
android_pad_ds_none: No wired DualSense or DualShock 4 detected.
android_pad_ds4_no_haptics: The DualShock 4 has no haptics audio device.
android_already_streaming: Already streaming — end this session first.
android_save_dialog_failed: Couldn't open a save dialog on this device.
android_link_file_unreadable: Couldn't read a Punktfunk link from that file.
android_link_pair_first: Pair with {host} first — a link can't establish trust.
android_link_by_id_only: A link can only reach {host} by its id — open it from the list.
android_link_host_unpaired: That link points at a host this device hasn't paired with.
android_overlay_app_capped: ⚠ app capped {rate} Hz by the system
android_overlay_panel_rate: ⚠ panel {rate} Hz, not {stream_rate} · check the game frame-rate limit
android_redial_gave_up: Lost the connection to {host} — the host may be asleep. Wake it to reconnect.
